name: Total Comfort Group
evidenceNote: Official website explicitly offers nationwide service through its own technicians, including commercial HVAC installation/maintenance, electrical services, and plumbing. Location coverage is service coverage, not inferred from licensing.

name: PR Services
evidenceNote: Official about page identifies PR Services, formerly Painter Ready, deploying its own crews in all 50 states for painting, flooring, electrical, plumbing and HVAC. Official exterior-services page additionally confirms commercial roof repairs, landscaping and concrete flatwork nationwide.

name: Inside Edge Commercial Interior Services
evidenceNote: Official website states coverage in every state and offers commercial flooring installation and interior/exterior painting by nationwide crews, serving both single-site projects and multi-location programs. Cabinetry is not treated as kitchen/bath remodeling.

name: Local Buckets
evidenceNote: Official nationwide-services page states that direct crews and managed partners mobilize across the US for concrete repairs, electrical work, epoxy flooring, interior/exterior painting, irrigation/landscaping, and roofing, under a single accountable facility-maintenance contract.

name: Horst Co
evidenceNote: Official services page explicitly names Florida, Alabama and Georgia among five states served; describes electrical wiring/panels, commercial supply/waste plumbing, and HVAC installation/replacement performed by its own crews.

name: Briggs Service, Inc.
evidenceNote: Official site identifies Briggs Service Inc, license ROC184355, and nationwide deployment for commercial, industrial and federal HVAC installation/replacement and maintenance. Only its core HVAC service is classified; trades sought from subcontractors are not separately counted.

name: MSC Floors
evidenceNote: Official about page identifies Michigan Specialty Coatings Inc d/b/a MSC Floors, its employed flooring installation crews and industrial painting division, and explicitly states nationwide operating capacity and service in southern states.

name: Fence Labor Corp
evidenceNote: Official website states nationwide mobilization for permanent chain-link fence installation, fence repair and custom gates; provides a direct company email and describes commercial, residential and government work. Temporary fence supply is not counted.

name: EOLA Power
evidenceNote: Official generator-installation page explicitly states nationwide coverage and commercial/industrial generator installation by its engineering team, including placement and electrical integration into critical power systems.

name: NPS Tree Experts
evidenceNote: Official site identifies nationwide commercial tree services by its arborists and trained crews, including hazardous tree removal, trimming/pruning, stump grinding and storm response, with a direct company-domain email.

name: Arctic Industrial Insulation, LLC
evidenceNote: Official site identifies the Sherman-based contractor and direct office contact, explicitly offers industrial insulation installation, maintenance and repair nationwide, and says its team mobilizes across the United States.

name: Facility Solutions Group
evidenceNote: Official national-accounts page offers nationwide electrical services through local branches and crews. Its commercial-generator page separately confirms nationwide design, installation and commissioning of large commercial backup generators; no residential generator service is inferred.

name: CTC Disaster Response
evidenceNote: Official website explicitly offers nationwide hazardous tree, limb and stump removal for public-agency disaster recovery, with owned equipment and offices/yards in Florida, Alabama and Louisiana. Counted as specialized tree work, not routine residential pruning; ctcdisaster.us and Sunderland ownership are not separate identities.

name: ATC Hilyer Services
evidenceNote: Official homepage explicitly says ATC Hilyer serves the entire state of Alabama and offers septic-tank flushing/emptying plus septic system maintenance and repair. This extends the existing ATC/Hilyer identity into septic services; its plumbing placements are not counted again.
